cutscene.speaker: NARRATOR
lines: You sprint through the corridors, alarms echoing.
The escape pod looms ahead, its metal cold under your touch.

cutscene.speaker: AI
lines: You may leave, but the facility will not wait for you.
Remember: survival comes at a cost.

cutscene.speaker: NARRATOR
lines: The pod hisses as it seals shut.
You leave behind the hum and flicker of dying lights.
The world outside is uncertain, but it is yours to live in.
